basic_details.short_information: Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital (GTBH), Office of the Medical Director, Govt. of NCT of Delhi, is engaging Senior Resident Doctors on an ad-hoc basis against 58 vacant posts in 13 departments, at Rs.67,700/- + NPA in pay level 11. Applications are made through a Google form that is de-activated on 19 November 2026 at 11:30 a.m., and interviews are held on 20 and 21 November 2026 at Skill Lab, 3rd Floor, Administration Block, GTB Hospital, Delhi.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 45 years as on the interview date, as per Order No. DHFW/Q015/57/2016-HR-Medical-Secy(H&FW)#1245062/1502-08 dated 26.11.2020. The notice prints no minimum age. The age limit is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates.

how_to_apply: Applications are invited online on the Google form at https://forms.gle/oPorMv3J9eDWaGUj7. The link is de-activated on 19 November 2026 at 11:30 a.m. Interviews follow on 20 and 21 November 2026.
Type or click the Google form link in a browser.
Fill in complete details in capital letters, as incomplete applications are liable to be rejected summarily, then click Submit.
Download the submitted Google application form from your email ID and take a print.
Paste one passport size photo on the first page of the form.
Attach the Demand Draft (if applicable) and other supporting documents, and sign all documents along with the application form.
Submit the duly filled application before the interview board on the day of interview at the time of attendance.
All required certificates (self-attested photocopies) must be attached with the Google form. Originals must be brought to the interview.
UR and OBC: Demand Draft of Rs.500/- in favour of "PAO-VIII GNCT of Delhi", annexed with the application. The fee is non-refundable.
The Demand Draft must be issued by a Delhi/NCR bank branch, on or after the date of publication of the advertisement.
SC/ST/PH/EWS candidates are charged no application fee.

Applicants must report at Skill Lab, 3rd Floor, Administration Block, GTB Hospital, Delhi at 09:30 A.M. or 01:30 P.M. (according to the interview schedule). They mark attendance there and submit self-attested photocopies of all testimonials and certificates. The department-wise schedule is in the vacancy table above.

Selection will be on the basis of interview. Fresh candidates and SRs who have completed 3 years are placed in separate merit lists. Selected candidates must report before the Staff Physician, GTBH, Delhi for medical examination. Results of selected candidates will also be informed by e-mail, so a valid and updated e-mail ID should be given. Selected candidates must report for duty within the prescribed period, before 11:00 am on a working day, or the candidature may be cancelled.
important_instructions: Candidates already in Govt. service must submit a No Objection Certificate from the present employer at the time of attendance. OBC candidates must submit a non-creamy layer caste certificate issued on or before the interview date by the Competent Authority of GNCT of Delhi, with the non-creamy layer for the current financial year. OBC candidates from outside Delhi are treated in UR (General) category. SC/ST certificates issued by the Judicial/Revenue Authorities as per M.H.A. Letter No. 36012/6/71-Estt. (SCT) dated 29.10.77 are accepted. EWS candidates must submit an EWS certificate issued on or before the interview date. Preference (extra marks) is given to candidates with life saving course certificates (BLS and ATLS/ACLS or equivalent), submitted at the interview. If applications are very high in number, the interview may continue on the next working days. This is informed verbally by Board Members at closing time, and a candidate not interviewed on the date must not leave without their knowledge. No separate communication will be made. No TA/DA will be paid for the interview. No correspondence or personal enquiries will be entertained. Any discrepancy in documents may invite cancellation of the offer of appointment as well as legal action under the relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Original certificates must also be produced at joining. Any query may be sent to [email protected]. The jurisdiction of court in any legal dispute is Delhi/New Delhi only.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Admissible emoluments are Rs.67,700/- + NPA in pay level 11, and other allowances as admissible under the rules. The initial appointment is for 44 days. It can be extended for a further 44 days, with a one day break, after a written request from the doctor that is recommended and forwarded by the concerned HOD, or till the appointment is done through the Central Appointment Committee, whichever is earlier. The maximum tenure of the Senior Resident post is 3 years, including the previous tenure served in any Govt. Hospital/Institute/Organization. The ad-hoc appointment does not give a claim over the post. When a regular appointee joins from the Central Appointment Committee, services will be terminated without any notice. SRs who have already completed 3 years may apply under relaxed criteria, admissible for one year on an ad-hoc basis. A separate merit list is prepared for fresh candidates and for these SRs, and the fresh candidates' list is exhausted first. The service will be governed by the Residency Scheme. Inter Hospital/Inter Institutional transfer is not permitted.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Resident Doctor vacancies are there at GTBH?
faq.answer: The notice lists 58 vacant posts in 13 departments. It adds that the number may vary in case of resignation or tenure completion of a Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GTBH Senior Resident Doctors?
faq.answer: The Google form link is de-activated on 19 November 2026 at 11:30 a.m. The duly filled form is then submitted at the interview on 20 or 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for GTBH Senior Resident Doctors?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree/DNB/PG Diploma is required. If such candidates are not available, MBBS with 3 years experience in relevant field may be considered. A valid DMC registration, or proof of application for it, is needed at the interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GTBH Senior Resident Doctors?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on the interview date. It is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a GTBH Senior Resident Doctor?
faq.answer: The admissible emoluments are Rs.67,700/- + NPA in pay level 11, and other allowances as admissible under the rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: UR and OBC candidates pay Rs.500/- by Demand Draft in favour of "PAO-VIII GNCT of Delhi", and the fee is non-refundable. SC/ST/PH/EWS candidates are not charged an application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for GTBH Senior Resident Doctors?
faq.answer: Fill the Google form at https://forms.gle/oPorMv3J9eDWaGUj7 and submit it. Then download the form from your email and print it, and paste a photo and attach the documents. Submit it to the interview board on the interview day.

faq.question: Q8. How are Senior Residents selected at GTBH?
faq.answer: Selection is on the basis of interview. Selected candidates then report to the Staff Physician, GTBH for medical examination.

faq.question: Q9. Is the GTBH Senior Resident post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is an ad-hoc engagement. The initial period is 44 days, extendable up to a maximum of 3 years including earlier tenure, and it ends when a regular appointee joins from the Central Appointment Committee.

faq.question: Q10. Can Senior Residents who have already completed 3 years apply?
faq.answer: Yes, they may apply under relaxed criteria, admissible for one year on an ad-hoc basis. A separate merit list is made, and the fresh candidates' list is used first.
